project.name: LiveForge
project.description: A modular, self-hosted multi-protocol live streaming server with protocol bridging, a web console, REST API, cluster relay, GB28181, and optional audio transcoding.

runtime_loader.read_path: atomic immutable snapshot; no file/network I/O or blocking waits
runtime_loader.failure_behavior: retain last valid snapshot and expose source status
runtime_loader.http_policy: runtime.source http requires an http URL and https requires an https URL; redirects are disabled; ETag and Last-Modified validators advance only after a document is accepted

runtime.startup_failure: report the original listener or module error and roll back only modules whose initialization was attempted; uninitialized later modules are not closed

default_build.note: The default build has no native FFmpeg requirement, but it still uses Go module dependencies.

capabilities.setup_policy: track IDs must be unique, valid, in range, and eligible for the announced or described media before transport allocation

requires: HTTPS or a browser-compatible secure context for browser camera and microphone access

capabilities.startup_policy: initial manifest waits for one complete segment without completed PART tags; blocking reloads retain the latest completed PART identity

install.availability: Requires a v* tag and a completed GitHub Release workflow; set the GHCR package to Public for anonymous pulls or authenticate with docker login
Requires a v* tag and a completed GitHub Release workflow; use a source or Docker audiocodec build for audio transcoding

api.authentication: Management accepts api.auth.bearer_token, named viewer/operator/admin tokens, or a console session when configured; GET /api/v1/server/health remains public; publish and subscribe auth are configured under auth.
api.runtime_config_status: GET /api/v1/server/config returns redacted source/version/failure/callback/restart state; POST /api/v1/server/config/refresh schedules asynchronous refresh.

console.recent_audit: inside Security; not a separate tab

whip_h265_opus_bridge.timeline: session-level RTP clock with packet-arrival track offsets; HTTP snapshot muxers use a combined target-audio/source-video transcode reader from the cached GOP cursor and filter cached video by video DTS; WebRTC audio transcoding waits on its reader condition without consuming the source playback wakeup
success_criteria: stable video pacing when source audio pauses

recording.dvr_media_authorization: synchronous subscribe authorization hooks only; no asynchronous subscribe lifecycle emission
recording.dvr_media_cors: non-credentialed wildcard CORS for split-port HLS playlist/segment fetches

console_playback.recordings: authenticated management API session; browser-native MP4/fMP4 and mpegts.js FLV/TS
console_playback.dvr: HLS on the separate dvr.listen media listener; Console does not persist or append bearer tokens

cluster.credential_resolution: atomic per request; api.auth.bearer_token then first named admin token

security.console_session_cookie: lf_session is HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, path=/, and Secure when the API listener uses TLS
security.audit: bounded in-memory entries plus structured logs with secret metadata redaction

limitations: There is no current public release until a v* tag completes the release workflow.
The Docker image is only available after the release workflow publishes it.
A GHCR package may require public visibility or registry authentication before docker pull works.
Audio transcoding is unavailable unless the audiocodec build tag and FFmpeg libraries are present.
WebRTC browser publishing and playback require correct ICE/TURN and secure-context configuration in real deployments.
Simulcast layer selection remains deferred; stream.simulcast is configuration-only.
